### Summary

A bound attribute whose value starts on a new line is reported as resolving to `any` / `unknown`. The same template literal on one line is not reported. A formatter wraps a long binding this way, so a long `:style` or `:aria-label` trips it.

### Version

- `vize` 0.443.0 (npm, bundled `@typescript/typescript-darwin-arm64` 7.0.2)
- Node v26.10.0, macOS arm64

`vize check` reports no type errors for the same file.

### Reproduction

`vize.config.json`

```json
{
  "linter": {
    "preset": "opinionated",
    "typeAware": true
  }
}
```

`tsconfig.json`

```json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ESNext",
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "strict": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "lib": ["ESNext", "DOM"]
  },
  "include": ["*.vue", "*.ts"]
}
```

`MultilineAttr.vue`

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
const x = 1;
</script>

<template>
  <p :title="`x: ${x}px`">not reported</p>
  <p
    :title="
      `x: ${x}px`
    "
  >
    reported
  </p>
</template>
```

`vize lint --format plain MultilineAttr.vue`

```
  MultilineAttr.vue:8:13 warning type/no-unsafe-template-binding Template binding resolves to an unsafe `any` or `unknown` type
```
